title: ctenopteris subsessilis
intro: Ctenopteris subsessilis, commonly known as the New Zealand fern, is a species of fern native to New Zealand and Australia. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include lowering fever, treating respiratory issues, and alleviating pain. The therapeutic actions of Ctenopteris subsessilis include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
